lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਐਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਜਿ ਤੋਰੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਂਠਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hai kooo aisaa meet j torai bikham gaa(n)th ||
lines.translation: Is there any such friend, who can untie this difficult knot?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਨਾਥੁ ਜਿ ਟੂਟੇ ਲੇਇ ਸਾਂਠਿ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ik sreedhar naath j toote lei saa(n)th ||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the One Supreme Lord and Master of the earth reunites the separated ones. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਉ ਦਸਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾਰਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaavau dasaa anek prem prabh kaarane ||
lines.translation: I run around in all directions, searching for the love of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਤਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਤ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਰਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch sataavahi doot kavan bidh maarane ||
lines.translation: The five evil enemies are tormenting me; how can I destroy them?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਖਣ ਬਾਣ ਚਲਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੵਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: teekhan baan chalaai naam prabh dhyaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Shoot them with the sharp arrows of meditation on the Name of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਮਹਾਂ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਘਾਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) mahaa(n) bikhaadee ghaat pooran gur paaeeai ||16||
lines.translation: O Lord! The way to slaughter these terrible sadistic enemies is obtained from the Perfect Guru. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur keenee daat mool na nikhutaee ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has blessed me with the bounty which shall never be exhausted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਵਹੁ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੁਟਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaavahu bhu(n)chahu sabh guramukh chhutaee ||
lines.translation: Eating and consuming it, all the Gurmukhs are emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤੁਸਿ ਹਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan ditaa tus har ||
lines.translation: The Lord, in His Mercy, has blessed me with the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਮਰਿ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sadaa araadh kade na jaa(n)hi mar ||17||
lines.translation: O Nanak, worship and adore the Lord, who never dies. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਏ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai jaae bhagat s thaan suhaavanaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever the Lord's devotee goes is a blessed, beautiful place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਹੋਏ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagale hoe sukh har naam dhiaavanaa ||
lines.translation: All comforts are obtained, meditating on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕਰਨਿ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮੁਏ ਪਚਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee karan jaikaar ni(n)dak mue pach ||
lines.translation: People praise and congratulate the devotee of the Lord, while the slanderers rot and die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: saajan man aana(n)d naanak naam jap ||18||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, O friend, chant the Naam, and your mind shall be filled with bliss. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਨ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਤਹ ਨਹੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: paavan patit puneet katah nahee seveeai ||
lines.translation: The mortal never serves the Immaculate Lord, the Purifier of sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਲਗੁ ਖੇਵੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothai ra(n)g khuaar kahaa(n) lag kheveeai ||
lines.translation: The mortal wastes away in false pleasures. How long can this go on?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haricha(n)dauree pekh kaahe sukh maaniaa ||
lines.translation: Why do you take such pleasure, looking at this mirage?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਜਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) hau balihaaree ti(n)n j daragahi jaaniaa ||19||
lines.translation: O Lord! I am a sacrifice to those who are known and approved in the Court of the Lord. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਗਵਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਘਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: keene karam anek gavaar bikaar ghan ||
lines.translation: The fool commits countless foolish actions and so many sinful mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਗੰਧਤ ਵਾਸੁ ਸਠ ਕਾ ਛਾਰੁ ਤਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa druga(n)dhat vaas sath kaa chhaar tan ||
lines.translation: The fool's body smells rotten, and turns to dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਤਉ ਗਰਬ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਹ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: phiratau garab gubaar maran nah jaanaee ||
lines.translation: He wanders lost in the darkness of pride, and never thinks of dying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਾਨਈ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) haricha(n)dauree pekh kaahe sach maanaee ||20||
lines.translation: O Lord! The mortal gazes upon the mirage; why does he think it is true? ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਪੂਜੈ ਅਉਧ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਰਾਖਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kee poojai audh tisai kaun raakhaee ||
lines.translation: When someone's days are over, who can save him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਦਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਹਾਂ ਲਉ ਭਾਖਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: baidak anik upaav kahaa(n) lau bhaakhaee ||
lines.translation: How long can the physicians go on, suggesting various therapies?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤਿ ਗਵਾਰ ਕਾਜਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਆਵਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko chet gavaar kaaj terai aavaee ||
lines.translation: You fool, remember the One Lord; only He shall be of use to you in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਵਈ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) bin naavai tan chhaar brithaa sabh jaavaee ||21||
lines.translation: O Lord! Without the Name, the body turns to dust, and everything goes to waste. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪੀਜਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aukhadh naam apaar amolak peejaee ||
lines.translation: Drink in the medicine of the Incomparable, Priceless Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਗਲ ਕਉ ਦੀਜਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil mil khaavahi sa(n)t sagal kau deejaee ||
lines.translation: Meeting and joining together, the Saints drink it in, and give it to everyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਵਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jisai paraapat hoi tisai hee paavane ||
lines.translation: He alone is blessed with it, who is destined to receive it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਾਵਣੇ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) hau balihaaree ti(n)nh j har ra(n)g raavane ||22||
lines.translation: O Lord! I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Love of the Lord. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੈਦਾ ਸੰਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਇਕਠਾ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaidaa sa(n)daa sa(n)g ikathaa hoiaa ||
lines.translation: The physicians meet together in their assembly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਖਦ ਆਏ ਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਖਲੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aukhad aae raas vich aap khaloiaa ||
lines.translation: The medicines are effective, when the Lord Himself stands in their midst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਓਨਾ ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo onaa karam sukaram hoi pasariaa ||
lines.translation: Their good deeds and karma become apparent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਹਾਂ ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਖਿਸਰਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: harihaa(n) dookh rog sabh paap tan te khisariaa ||23||
lines.translation: O Lord! Pains, diseases and sins all vanish from their bodies. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਬੋਲੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaubole mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Chaubolas, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਮਨ ਜਉ ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀ ਦਮ ਕੵਿਹੁ ਹੋਤੀ ਸਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)man jau is prem kee dam kyihu hotee saat ||
lines.translation: O Samman, if one could buy this love with money,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਵਨ ਹੁਤੇ ਸੁ ਰੰਕ ਨਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰ ਦੀਨੇ ਕਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raavan hute s ra(n)k nahi jin sir deene kaat ||1||
lines.translation: then consider Raawan the king. He was not poor, but he could not buy it, even though he offered his head to Shiva. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਤਨੁ ਖਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬੀਚੁ ਨ ਰਾਈ ਹੋਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: preet prem tan khach rahiaa beech na raaee hot ||
lines.translation: My body is drenched in love and affection for the Lord; there is no distance at all between us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ ਬੂਝਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal man bedhio boojhan surat sa(n)jog ||2||
lines.translation: My mind is pierced through by the Lotus Feet of the Lord. He is realized when one's intuitive consciousness is attuned to Him. ||2||
